jp: \t\t捧げ物をする為だけの最低限の設備が備わった簡素な祭壇。ここで祈ることにより神と交感できると言われている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t捧げ物をする為だけの最低限の設備が備わった簡素な祭壇。ここで祈ることにより神と交感できると言われている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Simple altar with minimal facilities for offerings. It is said that by praying here, one can commune with the Gods. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Simple altar with minimal facilities for offerings. It is said that by praying here, one can commune with the Gods. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Un altare spoglio, con giusto il minimo che serve per fare offerte. Dicono che pregando qui si entri in comunione col dio. \n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~

jp: \t\t厳かな雰囲気を醸し出す、石でできた巨大な構造物。ここで祈ることにより神と交感できると言われている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t厳かな雰囲気を醸し出す、石でできた巨大な構造物。ここで祈ることにより神と交感できると言われている。\n#～あなたの見知らぬ世界～\n"
en: Huge structure made of stone that creates a solemn atmosphere. It is said that by praying here, one can commune with the Gods. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~
en_grezzo: "Huge structure made of stone that creates a solemn atmosphere. It is said that by praying here, one can commune with the Gods. \n#~ Worlds you've Never Seen~"
it: Una costruzione enorme fatta di pietra, che spande intorno un'aria solenne. Dicono che pregando qui si entri in comunione col dio. \n#~I Mondi che Non Hai Mai Visto~
